summary: blockinfile's marker_end text plus the standard mode and owner file options, with guidance to quote octal modes.
questions: How do I customize the closing marker text?
How should I specify file permissions in blockinfile?
How do I set the owner of the modified file?

answer_card.title: blockinfile marker_end, mode, owner
answer_card.answer_md:
- `marker_end` (default `END`): text for `{mark}` in closing marker
- `mode`: quote octal (`'0644'`) or use symbolic (`u=rw,g=r`)
- `owner`: file owner
